Tobam Increased Position in Symantec Corp (SYMC) as Share Price Rose Posted by Hazel Jackson 30 pm
Investors sentiment increased to 1.41 in Q3 2018. Its up 0.50, from 0.91 in 2018Q2. It is positive, as 34 investors sold SYMC shares while 118 reduced holdings. 76 funds opened positions while 139 raised stakes. 530.27 million shares or 1.56% more from 522.12 million shares in 2018Q2 were reported. Renaissance Technology Ltd reported 1.95M shares or 0.04% of all its holdings. Cohen Klingenstein Limited owns 98,600 shares. Shufro Rose Ltd Llc owns 71,737 shares or 0.14% of their US portfolio. Switzerland-based Banque Pictet And Cie Sa has invested 0.02% in Symantec Corporation (NASDAQ:SYMC). 15,253 are held by Brighton Jones Limited Liability Company. South Dakota Invest Council stated it has 0.01% of its portfolio in Symantec Corporation (NASDAQ:SYMC). Arizona State Retirement Sys reported 154,051 shares. Crosslink reported 725,518 shares. Srb holds 27,027 shares or 0.06% of its portfolio. Teachers Retirement Systems Of The State Of Kentucky holds 64,634 shares. Starboard Value Lp invested 13.37% of its portfolio in Symantec Corporation (NASDAQ:SYMC). Kentucky Retirement Systems invested in 57,465 shares or 0.1% of the stock. Cubist Systematic Strategies Ltd Llc reported 13,441 shares stake. Earnest Partners Ltd Llc accumulated 0% or 390 shares. 887 are owned by Advisory Services Networks Ltd Limited Liability Company.
Tobam increased its stake in Symantec Corp (SYMC) by 18.69% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tobam bought 360,546 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.01% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 2.29M shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $48.73 million, up from 1.93M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tobam who had been investing in Symantec Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $14.23 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.91% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $22.28. About 15,429 shares traded. Symantec Corporation (NASDAQ:SYMC) has declined 19.88% since December 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.88% the S&P500.
Tobam, which manages about $5.57 billion and $2.34 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Autohome Inc (NYSE:ATHM) by 65,317 shares to 242,718 shares, valued at $18.79 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in P G & E Corp (NYSE:PCG) by 125,218 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 1.51 million shares, and cut its stake in Cvs Caremark Corp (NYSE:CVS).

The rating was maintained by Wedbush with “Neutral” on Friday, November 2. Stifel Nicolaus maintained it with “Hold” rating and $22 target in Tuesday, September 25 report. The firm has “Hold” rating by Stifel Nicolaus given on Friday, August 3. The rating was maintained by UBS on Friday, August 3 with “Neutral”. The firm earned “Positive” rating on Tuesday, August 21 by Susquehanna. On Friday, November 2 the stock rating was maintained by Robert W. Baird with “Neutral”. On Monday, July 30 the stock rating was maintained by Bank of America with “Underperform”. The rating was upgraded by Cowen & Co to “Market Perform” on Tuesday, October 16. As per Monday, August 6, the company rating was maintained by Barclays Capital. The stock of Symantec Corporation (NASDAQ:SYMC) earned “Hold” rating by Deutsche Bank on Friday, August 17.
